question: Doddabetta peak, which means a big mountain, is the highest mountain peak in the ________
solution:
The correct answer is " **Nilgiri Hills** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• At 2,623 mts above MSL, **Doddabetta is the highest Peak in Tamil Nadu** and is about 10 km from Ooty bus stand.
 
• The name Doddabetta literally means** ‘Big mountain’ **in the Badugu Language, which is so in reality.
 
• It is at the **junction of the Western and Eastern Ghats** and offers beautiful vistas of the Nilgiri Hills range.
 
• It is surrounded by **dense Sholas**. 
 
• The peaks **Hecuba** (2375 m), **Kattadadu** (2418 m) and **Kulkudi** (2439 m) are the three closely linked summits in the **west of the Doddabetta range near to Udagamandalam**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ananthagiri Hills** is located in **Vikarabad district, Telangana**, India. The water flows from these hills to Osman Sagar, also known as Gandipet lake, and Himayathsagar.
 
• **The Cardamom Hills or Yela Mala** are a mountain range of southern India and part of the southern Western Ghats located in the **Idukki district, Kerala, India.**
 
• **The Servarayan hills**, with the anglicised name Shevaroy Hills, are a towering mountain range (1620 m) near the city of** Salem, in Tamil Nadu state**, southern India.
